name: Update Ticket Field
description: Update a ticket field in Freshdesk. [See the documentation](https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/#update_ticket_field)

configurable_props.name: ticketFieldId
configurable_props.label: Ticket Field ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of a ticket field

configurable_props.name: label
configurable_props.label: Label
configurable_props.description: Display the name of the Ticket Field

configurable_props.name: labelForCustomers
configurable_props.label: Label for Customers
configurable_props.description: The label for the field as seen by customers

configurable_props.name: customersCanEdit
configurable_props.label: Customers Can Edit
configurable_props.description: Whether customers can edit the field

configurable_props.name: displayedToCustomers
configurable_props.label: Displayed to Customers
configurable_props.description: Whether the field is displayed to customers

configurable_props.name: position
configurable_props.label: Position
configurable_props.description: The position of the fieldPosition in which the ticket field is displayed in the form. If not given, it will be displayed on top

configurable_props.name: requiredForClosure
configurable_props.label: Required for Closure
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` if the field is mandatory for closing the ticket

configurable_props.name: requiredForAgents
configurable_props.label: Required for Agents
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` if the field is mandatory for agents

configurable_props.name: requiredForCustomers
configurable_props.label: Required for Customers
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` if the field is mandatory for customers

configurable_props.name: choices
configurable_props.label: Choices
configurable_props.description: Array of key, value pairs containing the value and position of dropdown choices. Example: `[{ "value": "Refund", "position": 1 }, { "value": "FaultyProduct", "position": 2 }]`

configurable_props.name: dependentFields
configurable_props.label: Dependent Fields
configurable_props.description: Applicable only for dependent fields, this contains details of nested fields Example: `[{ "label": "District", "label_for_customers": "District", "level": 2 }, { "label": "Branch", "label_for_customers": "Branch", "level": 3 }]`

configurable_props.name: sectionMappings
configurable_props.label: Section Mappings
configurable_props.description: Applicable only if the field is part of a section. This contains the details of a section (ID, position) for which it is been a part of. Example: `[{ "position": 3, "section_id": 1 }]`
